name: GET /api/auth/sso/:provider/start - begin Google or Microsoft sign-in
description: Public, browser navigation. Sets a signed httpOnly SameSite=Lax cookie holding state, nonce and the PKCE verifier (10 minutes) and answers 302 to the provider authorize URL (code flow, S256). A provider that is not configured returns 404 SSO_PROVIDER_DISABLED. Covers: a user can sign in with Google or Microsoft SSO.
environmentNote: Success redirects to the real identity provider, which needs configured OAuth credentials; the disabled-provider error is automated. The success case passes only where SSO_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID/SECRET are set; elsewhere the route returns 404 SSO_PROVIDER_DISABLED.
